claims.text: Severe pain: a brief course of danazol or tamoxifen; both inhibit estrogen and progesterone
claims.quote: If pain is severe, a brief course of danazol or tamoxifen may be given. These medications inhibit estrogen and progesterone.

claims.text: If estrogen or a progestin is being taken, stopping it may be necessary
claims.quote: If estrogen or a progestin is being taken, stopping may be necessary.
